name: Loyalty Suite
author: Loyalty Suite

sections.description:
Increase customer loyalty and sales with Loyalty Suite for WordPress & WooCommerce. Transform one-time buyers into loyal brand fans on WordPress & WooCommerce with a complete gamification and rewards platform for loyalty programs of any complexity.

Available in the following languages: English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Russian

⭐ Loyalty Suite Free version
⭐ Loyalty Suite PRO version
⭐ Loyalty Suite DEMO
⭐ Documentation

💰 ## Wallets — Points, Cashback & Virtual Currencies

Offer multiple virtual currencies—points and cashback—to gamify purchase experience and lift engagement. Build targeted, points-based rewards and tie balances into challenges to sustain ongoing activity.

  • Cashback wallets with configurable earn rates.
  • Pay with wallet at checkout (full or partial).
  • Custom conversion rates between points and currency.
  • Multiple wallets per user (points, cashback, XP).

🏆 ## Ranks — Tiered Status with Growing Perks

Create rank tiers based on spend, points, or actions. Motivate progress with escalating benefits, unlocking exclusive rewards and discount coupons at each level.

  • Multiple rank sets for different product categories or brands.
  • Sequential or flexible completion order (any-order progression).
  • Qualification by spend, points, or specific activities.
  • Per-rank perks: exclusive rewards, coupons, multipliers.

🏆 ## Achievements — Milestones That Motivate

Celebrate customer accomplishments with achievements that reflect activity and status. Add a clear sense of progression that keeps shoppers engaged and coming back.

  • Milestones for order count, spend, or streaks.
  • Engagement goals: reviews, referrals, social shares, UGC.
  • Progression badges and completion bonuses to re-engage users.

🚀 ## Challenges — Time-Limited Quests That Drive Sales

Launch seasonal or event-based challenges to promote specific products or categories. Turn shopping into an engaging game and reward consistent participation to boost repeat purchases.

  • Add missions inside a challenge; reward each mission separately.
  • Grant an extra reward for completing the full challenge.
  • Limit by time: start/end dates and scheduled launches.

📝 ## Conditions — Precise, Rule-Based Targeting

Trigger incentives with granular conditions—products, categories, spend thresholds, reviews, referrals, and social actions. Schedule and segment to deliver the right reward at the right moment.

  • On-site activity: logins, reviews, comments.
  • Purchase behavior: totals, frequency, product/category/brand filters.
  • Social actions: follows, shares, user-generated content.
  • Flexible targeting: include categories & brands, time windows, segmentation.

🎁 ## Rewards — Flexible Discounts & Incentives

Offer fixed or percentage discounts, rank/achievement perks, and coupon rewards.

  • Reward types: fixed/percentage discounts, rank & achievement rewards, coupon issuance.
  • Rule-based application by categories/brands, time windows, and minimum cart.
  • Trigger by order count or customer segments; set usage limits and stacking rules.
  • Auto-apply at checkout when eligibility criteria are met.

💡 ## Why does your WooCommerce Store need a Customer Loyalty Program?

  • Increase Customer Retention
  • Boost Average Order Value
  • Turn Buyers into Fans
  • Stand Out from Competitors
  • Collect Valuable Customer Insights
  • Encourage Social Sharing & Referrals
  • Support Personalized Marketing
  • Build Long-Term Brand Loyalty
  • Drive Sustainable Revenue Growth

Documentation

Full documentation: https://loyalty-suite.com/documentation/

Quick Start

  1. Install the plugin and activate it.
  2. After activation, go to LOYALTY SUITE in the WordPress Admin Panel.
  3. Open Settings to configure the plugin. In Settings, you can:
    1. Choose the placement of the loyalty program on your site.
    2. Make sure your WordPress Permalink structure is set to any option other than “Plain” (go to Settings → Permalinks) so that all loyalty pages and routes work correctly.
    3. Enable or disable the display of all loyalty features (by default, everything is active).
    4. Set up your store currency and number format in the CURRENCY tab.
    5. Customize the look & feel to match your site design in PUBLIC PAGE COLORS and CARD STYLES.
    6. Configure NOTIFICATIONS to inform users about new loyalty events.

When finished, click SAVE to apply your changes.

Source code for built assets

This plugin ships minified and compiled production assets under:
– includes/Admin/dist/
– includes/Account/dist/
– includes/Account/gutenberg/build/

The full human-readable source code and build configuration are included in this plugin under:
– includes/Admin/app/
– includes/Account/app/
– includes/Account/gutenberg/blocks/
– vite.config.ts, tsconfig.json, package.json

These source files contain the original Vue, TypeScript, and SCSS code used to generate the compiled assets.

Third-party libraries used in the build

The plugin build process depends on several open-source libraries. Their original human-readable sources and licenses can be found at:

  • Vue 3 — https://github.com/vuejs/core
  • Vue Router — https://github.com/vuejs/Router
  • Vue I18n — https://github.com/intlify/vue-i18n
  • Quasar — https://github.com/quasarframework/quasar
  • TinyMCE 4 — https://github.com/tinymce/tinymce
  • Swiper — https://github.com/nolimits4web/swiper
  • Luxon — https://github.com/moment/luxon
  • Vite — https://github.com/vitejs/vite
  • @wordpress/scripts (for blocks) — https://github.com/WordPress/gutenberg

Note: These libraries are bundled as part of the production assets for runtime use; their unminified source code is publicly available via the repositories above.
sections.faq:
What is a loyalty program plugin?

This is a WordPress tool that allows you to implement a loyalty program on your website. You can reward customers with points for purchases, registrations, reviews, or other actions, and they can then exchange these points for discounts or bonuses. Additionally, the plugin includes a wallet system, a ranking system to incentivize loyal customers, the ability to run various loyalty campaigns, detailed analytics to track effectiveness, and much more.

Who is this plugin for?

Our plugin is ideal for any WordPress business looking to increase customer retention, drive repeat purchases, and build a loyal community. This includes online stores, educational platforms, news portals, service companies, and many more.

Is the plugin difficult to install and set up?

No, our plugin is designed with ease of use in mind. Installation takes just a few minutes, and the intuitive interface makes it simple to configure point earning and redemption rules without needing to write any code.

Are special technical skills required?

No, they are not. The plugin is as user-friendly as possible for all skill levels. If you have any questions, our support team is always ready to help.

Is the plugin compatible with my WordPress theme and other plugins?

Our plugin is developed for broad compatibility. It works well with WordPress themes and popular plugins.

Is gamification supported?

Yes! You can use gamification elements to make the process more engaging for users, such as setting different loyalty levels, progress bars, or achievements for specific actions.
